description: This file defines an async helper function 'devTryProjectCost' used in development environments to simulate project cost history. It includes a check to disable its execution in production builds and returns mocked cost data after a delay.

methods.name: devTryProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: A helper function for local development that returns simulated project cost history, includes a production environment check, and introduces a delay before returning mock data.
